reviews.text: I can’t thank Snazzy Pawz enough had my fur babies groomed by them for the first time did an amazing job they look beautiful especially my Shipoo as the last groomers always struggled but Snazzy Pawz truly have a gift  as he was calm and well behaved and looks stunning thank you both you are truly wonderful Flixi and Charlie love you both and thank you x

I booked my Cavapoo in for a full groom today with Yasmin and I’m so happy that I did. My boy smells absolutely gorgeous and looks lovely. I would definitely recommend. Thank you again and we will see you when Red is due his next groom! 😀
It was the first time we had used Yasmin. She was very good with Merlin so we would certainly recommend her.Merlin was very calm when we collected him.

I recently got an American Akita pup called Kenzo and really wanted to find a good groomer for helping to keep his coat in great shape. I found Yazz by chance but I’m literally so grateful! The first time I left him she put my at ease and I came back to such a beautiful fluffy dog, we couldn’t stop cuddling him! More than anything, he was so happy and Yazz let him have a good play with her dog. Now he gets excited and pulls when I get there just to get in! I’ve started booking him for a regular groom every 4 weeks just to keep on top of it but can’t recommend Yazz enough ❤️
Super happy with my puppies first full groom. Would highly recommend.

Took my cocker spaniel for a trim and a bit of a tdy up,I was very impressed with the set up and felt that Lucy (my dog) was in food hands.Iwaa very happy to pick her up and find that not only was she looking gorgeous but she was also a very happy doggy,I will definitely take Lucy to Snazzy Pawz again and would 100% recommend anyone with a scruffy pup to employ Yazzy's services.

Freya wanted me to let you know she just loves her new nails
💕 🐾
As a large dog its been hard to find somewhere that will have her in as its all the little pups for grooming but you have saved the day.
Lovely service-We will be back
Excellent comms, price and overall very pleasant experience. Booking to have Milo groomed again as we speak. He smelt LOVELY 🥰 Thank You x

We've recently started taking our dog Muffin to her and she's wonderful, we were nervous because muffin is a rescue and were unsure how'd she'd do with strangers but she was amazing and patient with her.
Used Yasmin for the first time today and was very pleased. Mylo looks and smells beautiful, will definitely take him back there.
My Yorkshire terrier Berty is 14 years old but is always happy when having his hair trimmed. Excellent service cut, shower usually all done in less than 2 hours. Highly recommend

I was so cautious about leaving my small dog for her first grooming appointment with Yasmin. How unfounded that was. My dog looked stunning and was calm when I collected her. Just the same as the other dogs were. This is an excellent dog groomers. Highly recommended by me.
Really happy with the service, Yasmin was very nice and reassuring with Archies first groom with her, came home smelling lovely have rebooked.

We took Delilah to Yazzy for her first full groom at 7 months old and she done an amazing job! She listened to exactly how we wanted her to be cut and executed it perfectly. The pictures speak for themselves! Shes one happy pup now shes got all the fur off her!

I took my 16 week old puppy for her first groom experience. Of course I was a little worried about her but she was treated with love and gentleness.
Came out looking beautifully clean and groomed, and happy!! I have already booked for her next groom.

Yasmin is such a sweet and caring person. I brought Candy down for a full groom. She did such a great job, she literally looks like a little princess.
Moreover she is very responsive to messages and very polite.
Thank you again for everything ♥️

Today is the first time Yasmin has groomed my dogs, and I'm so happy because, Molly and Penny have been going to the same groomer for a long time and I was concerned they might have been a bit standoffish,but no they have taken to Yasmin straight away😘  🐾🐶, Yasmin is a very talented groomer,very caring with the dogs,and has done a brilliant job 👍,my girls look amazing 🐶,😉
This lady is sooo awesome like Helen very professional and sooooo good lovely & caring towards my beautiful dogs will always recommend them , thank you ladies xx

What fantastic service
Really pleased with how Max was groomed
Highly recommend
Jasmine was able to turn my ugly duckling into a Swan excellent job thanks
First time using Yaz and she was amazing. The cut was perfect, exactly what I asked for. I would highly recommend. You won’t be disappointed 🐶 …
Always a fantastic service and my pooches love yasmin.

Yasmin is amazing! It’s hard to find someone who truly understands a Chow Chow’s coat, but she did a fantastic job with my dog, Lucky. He came back looking beautiful, fluffy, and perfectly groomed while still keeping his natural look. Most importantly, he was calm and happy afterwards ❤️ Thank you Yasmin. Highly recommend! 🐾 …
Great job very friendly would certainly recommend
It came out very nicely and the service is very good.

I couldn’t be happier with the service! From the moment we walked in, the staff was friendly, professional, and genuinely caring with my dog. They took the time to listen to exactly what I wanted and delivered beyond expectations.

My dog came out looking absolutely amazing — perfectly groomed, soft, and smelling great! You can really tell they pay attention to detail and truly love what they do.
Dogs always look amazing and always really good service will always take my 2 dogs there
Yas is very professional and friendly she always cuts exactly how we ask and has been so good with our rescue puppy and made him feel comfortable and welcomed
Yasmin is a wonderful groomer. Friendly and very accommodating. Ted & Tess enjoying going and always come home looking amazing! Highly recommended.
Yasmin booked us in very last minute and she done an amazing job with Willow! Willow was comfortable and her groom looked brilliant! Highly recommend!

I was a bit nervous having to take Lola to a new groomers as she's very temperamental and nervous dog around new people ..But I was glad she came out look amazing ( That means she didn't attack the groomer to much as her face was all cut so the next positive sign) also Yasmin the  groomer said we could make another appointment..That was a blessing..Thank you so much she looks amazing your job isn't easy and we appreciate your patience and the time you took with our baby girl . see you soon ❤️

I'm absolutely thrilled with the service provided by Yasmin. She's incredibly skilled, patient, and genuinely loves animals. She did an amazing job with our Cocker Spaniel, who is a handful when visiting the dog groomers, but Yasmin worked her magic, and he came out looking happy and gorgeous. I will definitely be taking him back.
Highly recommend Yasmin to anyone who is looking for a kind and professional groomer!!!

I want to thank Yas so much for getting Coco through her first groom, she looks absolutely gorgeous. Reasonably priced and her approach to Coco who was a little nervous was fantastic and she was so kind. Coco smells amazing and the her trim all over looks so amazing. Also managed to clip her claws which she normally hates. We will definitely return and would highly recommend.

Luna has a wonderful experience seeing Yasmin. Luna is always happy to go to her as she always has a lovely time and is well looked after, which as a dog owner who treats her dog as their fur child is very important to me. Yasmin is kind and caring and always does what you ask for the groom. So happy to have found a decent groomer in our local area. Highly recommend to anyone.
Cannot rate Snazzy Paws enough!…. Excellent service and care when dealing with my mums Yorkshire Terrier… who is very nervous! Would highly recommend 😊 …

Our Cavachon has been groomed by Snazzy Pawz for over six months now, and each visit has been a fantastic experience. Every time he leaves, he looks absolutely beautiful, smells incredible, and is just as happy as when he first arrived. The trust & love shown for our pet makes Snazzy Pawz a highly recommended groomer.

I can't praise Snazzy Pawz enough. Yasmin is lovely, very welcoming and friendly. My boys can be difficult to groom, but yasmin was unfazed, she took her time to making sure they were calm and relaxed. She did a fantastic job. Will definitely book them in again. Thank you xx

Yasmin groomed our little tear away Cocker Spaniel Cookie yesterday and her service was excellent. Not only did she arrange a meet and greet ahead of time but on the day she spent over three hours giving our pampered pooch a full spa treatment. The level of her expertise in asking what you and your dog require was fantastic and the look of the cut was amazing. Dont just take my word for it see the before and after pictures to make your own mind up. We will be using Yasmin again in the future.

Yasmin has groomed our dogs on several occasions now and each and every time the service is exceptional. Despite the obvious grooming skills, Yasmin’s biggest asset is her patience with the pooches, you can really tell that this is a passion and not just a business. Highly recommended 5 star service.
Just had a wonderful experience with my dog groomer, I took my Beagle to Yas, she made him look a million dollars, 5 start service highly recommended to anyone.

5 stars don’t come close to to what this lady deserves, due to unfortunate circumstances we had a very matted cockapoo which would be a challenge for any groomer to achieve the amazing results that Yasmin achieved today! I couldn’t be more happier and appreciative of this lady’s absolutely amazing service, care and end result, she really has made an owner and beautiful dog very happy indeed! 😊 thank-you!

Wonderful experience with Snazzy Paws for our two Wired Fox Terriers - not the easiest of personalities to groom but were made to feel totally at ease thanks to Yaz. Fabulous groom! Will definitely be back.

Gabriel met Yazzy for the first time today. Only his second professional groom. Gabe looks lovely and seems to have enjoyed his groom. We will definitely be bringing him back in a few months when we are back in Birmingham.
